limitations: EXPLORATORY, UNVALIDATED results: in-sample (train) and validation only, placeholder/assumed costs, ~45 days of one market regime. Not evidence of profitability. The universe was ranked by CURRENT 24h volume (selection bias). Window ~45 days. Engine limitations: fills at next-bar open/level touch with half-spread 7.5 bps and an impact proxy; fees are placeholders/assumptions; the cost gate is fed the engine's worst-case slippage cap (50 bps) plus the full spread, so the round-trip cost it sees is much larger than realised costs. Warm-up bars before each segment are excluded from metrics. Missing-minute bars are kept and counted. No parameters were tuned.
